title: Design: Close window says no account is set and offers Set account
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Use a location that is connected to QuickBooks Online, with every ShopView Accounts row mapped.
  • Have a customer flagged as Internal customer, with one asset, and its default internal category left at General Internal.
  • Have General Internal with no QuickBooks expense account at this location.
  • Have a new internal work order for that customer with every line Complete and one stock part with a cost, made for this test.
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow1-17-7b-close-no-account-set.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the internal work order.
  2. Click Close Work Order.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • The Stock parts row's note reads "No account set for General Internal. The entry posts to the ShopView Review account until you set one." with a "Set account" link.
  • The button still reads "Close Work Order".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • S3-N4: “If no account is mapped for the work order's classification (for a no-charge work order in QuickBooks, no account for the work order's category), the confirmation of S3-R2 replaces the account note with: QuickBooks, "No account set for [category]. The entry posts to the ShopView Review account until you set one." with a "Set account" link to Integrations > QuickBooks; AccountingHub, "No account set for [category]. The entry is held in Accounting Events until you set one." with a link to Account Mappings. The link is shown only to users with 'Settings — Integrations' (QuickBooks) or 'Accounting — Settings' (AccountingHub); others see the note without the link. The Shop supplies row follows the same rule when the Shop supplies item is not mapped (S10-N2). The button still reads "Close Work Order" and closes as in S3-R3. At a QuickBooks location without Inventory Asset or Cost of Parts, the parts rows carry the note of S7-N5 instead.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: page "Flow 1 · Create and close", board "7b Close · no account set" (Flow 1 · Create and close).

The design's own words:

  • “Set account”

Difference: the design's note reads "No account set for internal work orders.": register IWO-D22, settled by S3-N4.
